title: Team capacity
description: Review planned work and reference availability before assigning more tasks.
method: Monday–Sunday, UTC. Estimates of open tasks without subtasks are spread across calendar dates. Absences reduce availability; overlapping days count once. Recorded time is not subtracted. This is the current plan, not a historical snapshot.
forbidden: Your role cannot manage team capacity.
error: Could not load capacity. Check the date and try again.
hidden: Some work is outside your access. Remaining capacity is unavailable to avoid presenting incomplete totals as free time.
unassigned: {{count}} visible tasks have no active team member assigned.
empty: No active members match this filter.
partial: Incomplete: {{estimates}} tasks without estimates; {{dates}} without valid dates. Review these tasks before allocating more work.
taskLimit: Showing the first 10 tasks. Open project details to review the remaining work.
settingsNote: Reference hours apply to every week before registered absences. Leave blank if unknown; zero means unavailable. Manage leave in Capacity scenarios. Holidays and daily schedules are not automatic. Values are rounded to minutes.
saveError: Could not save availability. Check the values and try again.
